chapter: Fish fries, passing the hat and district living
title: Coochie Morton, his brothers and the line-up at Harry Parker's
summary: Dawson describes Coochie Morton on guitar and his brothers, and his own band at Harry Parker's with Manetta on piano and John Vigne on drums.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What did Coochie Martin play when you were playing with him the other day?
Guitar. Oh, Coochie, uh, Coochie played guitar.
And you were playing guitar, too? Yeah.
Yeah. He had a, uh, he had a brother played drum, you know. Henry. Henry and the other brother played bass.
But you'd have two guitars and a bass, isn't it?

Ah, you see, uh, one guitar I had, when I had, when I had Harry Porphy's job, Charlie, there's two brothers. One of them had red, red hair, one of them had blonde hair. And there was, there was two brothers that had, uh, a ranch on, on, on, on Liberty, on, yeah, Liberty Street. And, um, I had Magma Net on a piano, John Veen, old man, we called it Tar-kun for nickname. John Veen on a drum.
